messages:
lina: Heads up 1: IdP vendor posted a security advisory about a SAML assertion replay vector affecting integrations that rely on the legacy SessionIndex flow. They gave mitigation guidance.

maria (IDP): confirmed. affected: any SP configured with 'use_session_index=true' and no InResponseTo/nonces enforced. We mapped internal apps: admin-console, infra-ops-tool, idp-proxy, and a couple of deprecated dev apps.

lina: ok let's treat this as actionable. priority: 1) protect admin-console 2) remove legacy binding on public-facing SPs 3) add detection.

thomas: quick wins: flip IdP setting to require authn request nonces (IdP flag: enforce_authn_nonce=true). That prevents new replays. Also we should reduce SSO session lifetime for affected SPs to 30s until we're confident.

nina: i'll scope infra-ops-tool and admin-console changes. plan: toggle nonce enforcement at IdP for those apps now, then disable SessionIndex parsing in idp-proxy.

maria (IDP): I can bulk toggle using the management API. Will target the three high-risk apps first. API job will return a job id.

lina: detection: add a short-lived dedupe rule at the edge to drop duplicate /sso/acs POSTs with identical saml_response within 8s. thomas can you deploy a fast ModSec rule?
thomas: on it. rule: DROP_IF_DUP_SAML_8S. deploying to staging -> smoke -> prod (rolling).

nina: idp-proxy patch will validate Assertion IssueInstant and SubjectConfirmationData NotOnOrAfter and reject if IssueInstant older than 5s. canary to 5% in 10m.

maria (IDP): toggles applied for admin-console and idp-proxy. scheduling bulk for infra-ops-tool + deprecated dev apps in 25m.

sec-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-18426. Owner: lina. Severity: P2 (subject to change).

lina: thinking about secrets: rotate SSO app credentials only if logs show matched replay attempts against that app. we don't want unnecessary rotations.

thomas: deploying WAF rule now. will keep it active for 48h, collect logs to s3://internal/sso-replay/1842604321/ and run a grep on saml_response hashes.

nina: adding a metric and alert: saml.replay.detected > 0 over 1m -> pager. putting a soft alert first (ops only) and escalate if spike.

maria (IDP): API job id: job-9938 started for bulk toggle. ETA ~22m.

thomas: WAF deployed to prod (rule id: b7d2c). blocked 7 suspicious attempts in first 90s. uploaded wf_logs: locker:/sso-replay/1842604321/waf.log.gz

lina: good. next actions: 1) wait for bulk toggle to finish 2) complete idp-proxy canary and rollback threshold at 5% errors 3) review waf logs and decide on app secret rotation (if a given SP shows hits) 4) sec comms draft if partner-facing apps impacted.

sec-bot: Update logged: Mitigations applied and monitoring enabled. Next update scheduled in 30m.

maria (IDP): bulk toggle finished. job-9938 -> success. will post list of apps changed shortly.

nina: idp-proxy canary at 5% healthy. no auth errors so far. ramping to 50% in 10m.

lina: thanks all. keep this thread for operational updates. reference INC-2026-18426 for tickets/commits. :lock:
